title: FielderTouch
description: Physical touch vocabulary — never official-scoring language (spec §4.2, §13). Official errors are DERIVED.

anchorEventId.description: the play this touch belongs to: the BallInPlay it was hit on, or — for a between-pitch entry (§15.6) — the PitchThrown it hangs off. A grouping key; the engine does not require it to resolve.

ordinaryEffort.description: scorer judgment on misplays; inferred default, overridable post-hoc (§13.2)

receivedQuality.description: how a received_throw arrived (§13, §22.1). Default clean; purely developmental, never affects official scoring.
